Messages.Author: Crucified by Gravity
Messages.Body:
Having struggled with the reasoning behind such an apparently useless
card as Goodnight, Sweet Prince, I have come up with a possible reason
for the two pool cost for only a possible 2 pool gain (net=0 if
successful in its use). The question is; can this card be used on the
acting Methuselah's own crypt? The card text says: "... Move the next
vampire in the crypt of any Methuselah to that Methuselah's ash heap.
..". The use of the word "any" seems to indicate that it may in fact
be used upon the acting Methuselah's own crypt.
I have looked at the compiled "official" rulings from this news group
and other sources, and have not found any rulings to the contrary,
except that (D) actions may not be directed at the acting Methuselah's
own minions/region unless stated othere in the card text. As this
master card is not directed, this ruling does not seem to apply. An
official word from Tom would be appreciated. Thanx.

Messages.Author: Crucified by Gravity
Messages.Body: Oops! Damn computers with sticky mice.
